question: Does the J8V finite positive second-record witness retain nonzero, quantitatively bounded weight after all unmeasured private errors with the same first flux are admitted?
fork_classification: Exact same-flux posterior bounding is the cheap prerequisite to any broader operator-law reduction or full-channel assertion; no human ranking is needed. It uses already verified exact sector priors and matched public laws, without new Born terms.
frozen_model: R6AF ideal periodic L=2 D4, 36 IID red-X edges at p_X=1/10 and p_Z=0. Reuse J8V's three prospectively selected equal-prior three-edge same-first-flux pairs, each full all-zero-charge first public record, and two fixed relation-free public charge actions [0] and [1,30,32,34,35]. Private supports are generation/scoring only. Do not change J8V selection or public-law interface.
estimand: For each selected sector, use the exact physical prior of its complete first-flux coset and the two evaluated equal first likelihoods. Bound the omitted same-flux first-record mass only by 0<=P(first record|omitted private error)<=1. Report a lower bound on the selected pair's posterior conditional on the same complete first record, and a reverse-triangle lower bound on total variation between one selected error's conditional second law and the law for its full private-error complement, separately for each fixed action. These are conditional finite-sector bounds, not evaluated omitted public laws.

hypotheses.positive: At least one fixed-action complement-TV lower bound remains strictly positive after worst-case omitted same-flux contamination.
hypotheses.censored: All lower bounds collapse to zero or an integrity gate fails; do not infer a full-mixture effect.
hypotheses.scope_limit: Even a positive bound is not full-IID mutual information, logical Bayes-risk improvement, noisy JIT, size scaling, or threshold.

matrix.cells: The three immutable J8V pairs crossed with their two fixed actions; compare exact rational bounds and do not add sectors or substitute errors.
matrix.independent_unit: An exact private-error/first-record/action cell; no stochastic samples or uncertainty interval.
matrix.integrity: Verify J8V source hash/status, physical prior, both three-edge distinct equal-likelihood errors, three strata, nonnegative omitted sector prior, normalized posterior envelope, two exact J8V paired TVs in [0,1], source/hash stability and zero new Born terms/histories/arms/bootstraps.

acceptance: All three sector posterior envelopes computed exactly from the frozen J8V inputs
Both actions per stratum have exact conservative complement-TV bounds
Any positive inference is restricted to the selected complete-first-record finite sector; unknown omitted laws and full-IID conclusions remain explicit
stop_rule: Stop after the fixed three-sector/two-action arithmetic matrix or first integrity/5-CPU-second cap; no Born evaluations, history generation, adaptive selection or budget increase.
